features.name: meal_price
features.missing_policy: Use 0 when no price is available; keep raw price features out of hard budget filtering.

features.name: calories
features.missing_policy: Use 0 only when a stored meal has no calories; recommendation matching already prefers complete nutrition.

features.name: protein
features.missing_policy: Use 0 only when protein is missing.

features.name: carbs
features.missing_policy: Use 0 only when carbohydrates are missing.

features.name: fat
features.missing_policy: Use 0 only when fat is missing.

features.name: calorie_difference
features.missing_policy: Use 0 until a reliable explicit calorie target exists; do not infer medical safety from this value.

features.name: price_difference_from_avg
features.missing_policy: Use 0 when no historical spending exists before shown_at.

features.name: times_meal_eaten
features.missing_policy: Use 0 when the meal has never been logged before shown_at.

features.name: times_category_eaten
features.missing_policy: Use 0 when matching categories have never been logged before shown_at.

features.name: days_since_last_eaten
features.missing_policy: Use 999 when the meal has never been logged before shown_at.

features.name: remaining_monthly_budget
features.missing_policy: Use 0 when budget is missing or already exceeded.

features.name: average_meal_spending
features.missing_policy: Use 0 when no meal spending history exists before shown_at.

features.name: category_match
features.missing_policy: Use 0 when there is no preferred-tag intersection.

features.name: meal_type
features.missing_policy: Use other when request meal category is absent or unsupported.

deferred_features.name: cuisine_match
deferred_features.reason: Meal categories mix cuisine and dish taxonomy without a dedicated cuisine field, so this is deferred until cuisine data is explicit.

history_cutoff_policy: All history-derived features must use only rows with event timestamps at or before shown_at.
